```{r}
library(ggplot2, help, pos = 2, lib.loc = NULL)
Metadata_Popgen_Ethiopia_withfws = read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/hrp2_analysis/pop_stat_jostD/metadata_pop_gen.tsv",sep="\t")
fix_with_AD_gat_filt <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/hrp2_analysis/pop_stat_jostD/fix_with_AD_gat_filt.csv")

metadata_mono <- Metadata_Popgen_Ethiopia_withfws%>% 
  filter(fws >= 0.95)

# filtering to sample that I know populations for 
fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known = fix_with_AD_gat_filt %>% 
  filter(sample %in% metadata_mono$Sample) %>% 
  group_by(CHROM, POS, sample) %>%
  mutate(total_AD = sum(AD)) %>% 
  mutate(wsaf = AD/total_AD) %>% 
  left_join(Metadata_Popgen_Ethiopia_withfws %>% 
              select(Sample, site) %>% 
              dplyr::rename(sample = Sample))

# since taking a subset of samples, filter to positions where there are more than one variant 
fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation = fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known %>% 
  group_by(CHROM, POS) %>% 
  filter(n_distinct(base) > 1)

# get within sample frequency weighted allele freqs, by taking a within sample frequency can mitigate somewhat the fact we don't know COI 
fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation_allele_freqs = fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation %>% 
  group_by(CHROM, POS, site) %>% 
  mutate(total_wsaf = sum(wsaf)) %>% 
  group_by(CHROM, POS, base, total_wsaf, site) %>% 
  summarise(wsaf_sum = sum(wsaf)) %>% 
  mutate(allele_freq = wsaf_sum/total_wsaf) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(total_population_sample_count = total_wsaf, 
                population = site) %>% 
  unite(CHROM_POS, CHROM, POS, sep = "-", remove = F) %>% 
  arrange(CHROM, POS, base, population)
```

```{r}
metadata_all <- Metadata_Popgen_Ethiopia_withfws

# All samples (polyclonal + monoclonal)
fix_all_samples <- fix_with_AD_gat_filt %>% 
  filter(sample %in% metadata_all$Sample) %>% 
  group_by(CHROM, POS, sample) %>%
  mutate(total_AD = sum(AD),
         wsaf = AD/total_AD) %>%
  left_join(metadata_all %>% select(Sample, site) %>% dplyr::rename(sample = Sample)) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, POS, site) %>%
  mutate(total_wsaf = sum(wsaf)) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, POS, base, total_wsaf, site) %>%
  summarise(wsaf_sum = sum(wsaf), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(allele_freq = wsaf_sum / total_wsaf) %>%
  dplyr::rename(population = site)
allele_freq_compare <- fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation_allele_freqs %>%
  select(CHROM, POS, base, population, allele_freq) %>%
  rename(allele_freq_mono = allele_freq) %>%
  left_join(
    fix_all_samples %>% select(CHROM, POS, base, population, allele_freq) %>%
      rename(allele_freq_all = allele_freq),
    by = c("CHROM", "POS", "base", "population")
  ) %>%
  mutate(freq_shift = allele_freq_all - allele_freq_mono)
# Summary
allele_freq_compare %>% summarise(mean_shift = mean(abs(freq_shift)),
                                  max_shift = max(abs(freq_shift)),
                                  min_shift = min(freq_shift))

# Histogram of shifts
library(ggplot2)
pdf("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/hrp2_analysis/pop_stat_jostD/allele_frequency_shift.pdf",width = 10, height = 6)
ggplot(allele_freq_compare, aes(x = freq_shift)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~population)+
  labs(title = "Allele frequency shifts due to including polyclonal samples",
       x = "Frequency shift (all - monoclonal)",
       y = "Count")
dev.off()

```

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggnewscale)

jostd_ann_site <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/jostD_stat/pop_stat_jostD/ethopia_by_site_JostD_new_annotate.csv.gz")

print(colnames(jostd_ann_site))

# i am trying to find out if there is any interesting result after doing the jostD
# for the hrp groups but not found an interesting result. 
jostd_ann_site_filter <- jostd_ann_site%>%
  select(CHROM,pop1,pop2,JostD,Gene_name,POS)%>%
  filter(JostD > 0.5)
print(unique(jostd_ann_site$pop1))

jost_plot <- jostd_ann_site_filter %>%
  filter(CHROM != "Pf3D7_API_v3") %>%
  mutate(
    pop1 = ifelse(pop1 == "Arba Minch", "Arba Minch", pop1),
    pop2 = ifelse(pop2 == "Arba Minch", "Arba Minch", pop2),
    pop1 = ifelse(pop1 == "Gambella", "Gambella", pop1),
    pop2 = ifelse(pop2 == "Gambella", "Gambella", pop2),
    pop1 = ifelse(pop1 == "Gondar", "Gondar", pop1),
    pop2 = ifelse(pop2 == "Gondar", "Gondar", pop2),
    pop1 = ifelse(pop1 == "Metehera Fentale", "Metehera Fentale", pop1),
    pop2 = ifelse(pop2 == "Metehera Fentale", "Metehera Fentale", pop2),
    pop1 = ifelse(pop1 == "Mizan", "Mizan", pop1),
    pop2 = ifelse(pop2 == "Mizan", "Mizan", pop2),
  ) %>%
  #filter(pop1 %in% districts$site & pop2 %in% districts$site) %>%
  mutate(
    chr_num = as.numeric(gsub("Pf3D7_", "", gsub("_v3", "", CHROM))),
    Comparison = paste(pop1, "vs", pop2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(chr_num, POS) %>%
  group_by(chr_num) %>%
  mutate(pos_index = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()


   #Calculate cumulative position for each chromosome
chr_lengths <- jost_plot %>%
  group_by(chr_num) %>%
  summarise(max_pos = max(pos_index), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    cum_pos = cumsum(as.numeric(max_pos)) - max_pos,
    chr_center = cum_pos + max_pos/2
  )

# Add cumulative position to data
jost_plot <- jost_plot %>%
  left_join(chr_lengths %>% dplyr::select(chr_num, cum_pos), by = "chr_num") %>%
  mutate(x_pos = pos_index + cum_pos)

# First, identify genes that appear more than 4 times with Fst > 0.7
# I tried to lower fst from 0.7 to 0.5 and 5 gene name count to 3
high_jost_genes <- jost_plot %>%
  filter(JostD > 0.7) %>%
  count(Gene_name) %>%
  filter(n >5) %>%
  pull(Gene_name)

# Add a column to identify which points should be colored 
# change the colored points to 0.5
jost_plot <- jost_plot %>%
  mutate(highlight = ifelse(JostD > 0.5 & Gene_name %in% high_jost_genes, Comparison, "Other"))

# Filter for plotting (Fst > 0.5)
jost_plot_filtered <- jost_plot %>% filter(JostD > 0.5)

# Then filter the data for labeling
labels_data <- jost_plot %>%
  filter(JostD > 0.5, Gene_name %in% high_jost_genes)

gene_regions <- data.frame(
  gene_name = c("CRT", "UT", "ACS8", "hyp12", "PF3D7_0705500", 
                "PF3D7_1321100", "PF3D7_1408700", "PF3D7_1448500", "PF3D7_1321300"),
  chr = c("Pf3D7_07_v3", "Pf3D7_07_v3", "Pf3D7_02_v3", "Pf3D7_07_v3", 
          "Pf3D7_07_v3", "Pf3D7_13_v3", "Pf3D7_14_v3", "Pf3D7_14_v3", "Pf3D7_13_v3"),
  start = c(402385, 214949, 628091, 83838, 269635, 
            861001, 324334, 1983780, 876120),
  end = c(406341, 230713, 632681, 86436, 280332, 
          872925, 347119, 1996262, 886756),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Extract chromosome number
gene_regions$chr_num <- as.numeric(gsub("Pf3D7_", "", gsub("_v3", "", gene_regions$chr)))

# Initialize x position columns
gene_regions$x_start <- NA_real_
gene_regions$x_end <- NA_real_



gene_regions_with_pos <- gene_regions

library(ggforce)  # For drawing half circles

# Define site colors - these match your data exactly
print(unique(jostd_ann_site$pop1))

site_colors <- c(
  "Arba Minch" = "#f8766d",       # red         # orange
  "Gambella" = "#00bf7d",            # cyan
  "Gondar" = "#00b0f6",  # blue
  "Metehera Fentale" = "#eaf36b" ,
  "Mizan" = "#e76bf3"           # magenta
)

# Create left and right datasets
fst_left <- jost_plot_filtered %>%
  filter(highlight != "Other") %>%
  mutate(
    x_adj = x_pos - 0.15,
    site_color = pop1
  )

fst_right <- jost_plot_filtered %>%
  filter(highlight != "Other") %>%
  mutate(
    x_adj = x_pos + 0.15,
    site_color = pop2
  )

# Filter for semicircles
fst_semicircles <- jost_plot_filtered %>%
  filter(highlight != "Other")
candidate_genes <- c("CRT", "FP2B", "UBP1","ABCF1","gene:PF3D7_0720700","AP2-O","AP2-G","HP1","GDV1")

p <- ggplot(jost_plot_filtered, aes(x = x_pos, y = JostD)) +
  
  # --- Gene regions (transparent, colored by gene_name) ---
  geom_rect(
    data = gene_regions_with_pos,
    aes(xmin = x_start - 100,
        xmax = x_end + 100,
        ymin = 0.5,
        ymax = 1,
        fill = gene_name),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.25        # make much lighter
  ) +
  # geom_rect(
  #   data = gene_regions_with_pos,
  #   aes(xmin = x_start - 100,
  #       xmax = x_end + 100,
  #       ymin = 0.5,
  #       ymax = 1,
  #       color = gene_name),
  #   fill = NA,
  #   linewidth = 0.8,
  #   inherit.aes = FALSE
  # ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(
    option = "viridis",
    alpha = 0.25  # Add alpha here in the scale
  )+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    guide = "none", 
    option = "viridis",
    alpha = 0.25  # Add alpha here in the scale
  )+
  
  # --- Gene labels (repelled text) ---
  #geom_text_repel(
  #data = gene_regions_with_pos,
  #aes(x = (x_start + x_end) / 2, y = 0.98, label = gene_name),
  #inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #size = 3,
  #fontface = "bold",
  #color = "black",
  #bg.color = "white",
  #bg.r = 0.15,
  #max.overlaps = 100
  #) +
  
  # --- Reset fill/color scales for Fst points ---
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  
  # --- Background points ---
  geom_point(
    data = jost_plot_filtered %>% filter(highlight == "Other"),
    color = "grey70", alpha = 0.3, size = 2
  ) +
  
  # --- Outer ring (pop2) ---
  geom_point(
    data = fst_semicircles,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = JostD, color = pop1),

  ) +
  
  # --- Inner fill (pop2) ---

    data = fst_semicircles,

scale_fill_manual(values = site_colors, name = "Inner: Pop1") +
scale_color_manual(values = site_colors, name = "Outer: Pop2")+
  
  # --- Axes & layout ---
  scale_x_continuous(

  labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "JostD Value") +

)
